privacyPolicy: Published exact counts are preserved; <N suppressions and unlisted cells are unavailable, never zero, never back-calculated. Percentages and total enrollments withheld when not independently published. No student-level data.

domains.notes: The Closing the Gaps unscaled component is separately preserved; do not substitute it for scaled domain score.

staar.metric: All Students — percent of tests at Meets Grade Level standard or above

analysis.method: Compare only the four published All Students STAAR Meets percentages within the campus. No causal explanations or student demographic quality judgement.
